title: 让AI辅助声明可独立质疑：出版权威与可证伪出版记录协议
summary: 论文提出"出版权威"概念，即一种精确状态、不可转让、单次使用的出版能力，并在PAC-2026（出版问责演算）中实例化。该协议通过六项义务（证据、运行与工件、测量披露、授权、表面一致性、生命周期连续性）约束AI辅助声明，只有全新且全部通过的记录才能获得一次原子出版转换的许可。实验探索了110,764个安全可达状态，验证了内部一致性、有界安全性和故障敏感性。
summary_en: The paper introduces Publication Authority as an exact-state, non-transferable, single-use publication capability, instantiated in PAC-2026 (Publication-Accountability Calculus), a machine-readable AIJIM Protocol candidate. Six obligations govern evidence, runs and artifacts, measurement disclosure, authorization, surface correspondence, and lifecycle continuity. Only a fresh, complete all-pass record derives the permit consumed by one atomic publication transition. Ten models explored 110,764 safe reachable states, supporting internal coherence, bounded safety, fault sensitivity, and limited constructibility.
